chunks.title: Dental emergencies
chunks.heading: Same-day emergency appointments
chunks.text:
Dental emergencies > Same-day emergency appointments
If you have severe tooth pain, a broken or knocked-out tooth, or a swollen face, call us as early as you can. We keep a few same-day emergency slots each weekday, and calls before 10:00 am have the best chance of getting one.

chunks.title: Dental emergencies
chunks.heading: Outside opening hours
chunks.text:
Dental emergencies > Outside opening hours
Our voicemail is checked every evening and every Saturday morning. If swelling affects your breathing or swallowing, or after a serious injury, go to the nearest hospital emergency department or call your local emergency number.

chunks.title: Frequently asked questions
chunks.heading: Is treatment painful?
chunks.text:
Frequently asked questions > Is treatment painful?
We use local anaesthetic for fillings, root canals and implants, and we explain each step before we start. Tell us at any time if you want a break.

chunks.title: Frequently asked questions
chunks.heading: Do you help nervous patients?
chunks.text:
Frequently asked questions > Do you help nervous patients?
Yes. We offer nitrous oxide (laughing gas) for anxious patients and longer appointments so nobody feels rushed. We do not offer general anaesthesia or IV sedation.

chunks.title: Frequently asked questions
chunks.heading: How often should I have a check-up?
chunks.text:
Frequently asked questions > How often should I have a check-up?
Most patients should have a check-up and cleaning every six months. The dentist may suggest a different schedule for you.

chunks.title: Frequently asked questions
chunks.heading: Do you see emergencies?
chunks.text:
Frequently asked questions > Do you see emergencies?
Yes, we keep same-day emergency slots on weekdays. See the Dental emergencies page.

chunks.title: Frequently asked questions
chunks.heading: Can I bring my child?
chunks.text:
Frequently asked questions > Can I bring my child?
Yes. We see children from age 2, and a parent stays with the child during the visit.

chunks.title: Hours and location
chunks.heading: Opening hours
chunks.text:
Hours and location > Opening hours
- Monday to Thursday: 8:00 am to 5:00 pm
- Friday: 8:00 am to 2:00 pm
- Saturday: 9:00 am to 1:00 pm, by appointment only
- Sunday: closed

We are closed on public holidays.

chunks.title: Hours and location
chunks.heading: Find us
chunks.text:
Hours and location > Find us
Acme Dental is at 214 Maple Street, Springfield. The building is wheelchair accessible. There is free parking behind the building, and the nearest bus stop is Maple and 3rd.

chunks.title: Hours and location
chunks.heading: Contact
chunks.text:
Hours and location > Contact
Phone (555) 010-0142, email hello@acmedental.example. We answer calls during opening hours and reply to emails within one working day.

chunks.title: Acme Dental – family dentistry in Springfield
chunks.heading: Acme Dental
chunks.text:
Acme Dental – family dentistry in Springfield > Acme Dental
Acme Dental is a friendly family dental practice in Springfield. We look after children, adults and anxious patients, and we aim to keep visits calm, clear and on time.

chunks.title: Acme Dental – family dentistry in Springfield
chunks.heading: Acme Dental > What we do
chunks.text:
Acme Dental – family dentistry in Springfield > Acme Dental > What we do
We offer check-ups and cleanings, fillings, teeth whitening, clear aligners, dental implants, root canal treatment and children's dentistry. Details and prices are on our Services and Pricing pages.

chunks.title: Acme Dental – family dentistry in Springfield
chunks.heading: Acme Dental > Book a visit
chunks.text:
Acme Dental – family dentistry in Springfield > Acme Dental > Book a visit
Call the front desk on (555) 010-0142 or email hello@acmedental.example. We are open Monday to Saturday; see Hours and location for the exact times. New patients are welcome.

chunks.title: Insurance and payment
chunks.heading: Insurance
chunks.text:
Insurance and payment > Insurance
We are in-network with SunShield Dental and BlueHarbor Dental plans. For other plans we can give you an itemised receipt to claim back yourself. Please bring your insurance card to your first visit so we can check your cover.

chunks.title: Insurance and payment
chunks.heading: Ways to pay
chunks.text:
Insurance and payment > Ways to pay
We accept major credit and debit cards, bank transfer, and HSA or FSA cards. We do not accept cheques. Payment is due at the time of treatment unless you have agreed a payment plan.

chunks.title: New patients
chunks.heading: Your first visit
chunks.text:
New patients > Your first visit
A first visit takes about 60 minutes. It includes a full examination, X-rays if you need them, a cleaning when time allows, and a plan explained in plain language. You will get a written quote for any treatment before it begins.

chunks.title: New patients
chunks.heading: What to bring
chunks.text:
New patients > What to bring
Please bring a photo ID, your insurance card if you have one, a list of any medicines you take, and any recent dental X-rays from your previous dentist.

chunks.title: New patients
chunks.heading: Forms
chunks.text:
New patients > Forms
You can fill in the new patient form online before your visit, or arrive 10 minutes early and complete it at the front desk.

chunks.title: New patients
chunks.heading: Cancellations
chunks.text:
New patients > Cancellations
Please give us at least 24 hours notice if you need to change or cancel an appointment. Late cancellations and missed appointments may be charged a $40 fee.

chunks.title: Pricing
chunks.text:
Pricing
All prices are estimates in US dollars and may change after an examination. You will always get a written quote before treatment starts.

chunks.title: Pricing
chunks.heading: Payment plans
chunks.text:
Pricing > Payment plans
For treatment over $500 we offer interest-free payment plans over 6 or 12 months. Ask the front desk to set one up before your treatment starts.

chunks.title: Our services
chunks.heading: Check-ups and cleaning
chunks.text:
Our services > Check-ups and cleaning
A routine check-up includes an examination, digital X-rays when needed, and advice on your home care. A professional cleaning removes plaque and tartar. We suggest a check-up and cleaning every six months for most patients.

chunks.title: Our services
chunks.heading: Fillings
chunks.text:
Our services > Fillings
We repair cavities with tooth-coloured composite fillings that match your natural teeth. Most fillings take one visit of about 45 minutes.

chunks.title: Our services
chunks.heading: Teeth whitening
chunks.text:
Our services > Teeth whitening
We offer two options: in-office whitening, done in one visit of about 75 minutes, and a take-home whitening kit with custom trays that you use for two weeks. Whitening is not suitable for everyone, and the dentist will check your teeth and gums first.

chunks.title: Our services
chunks.heading: Clear aligners
chunks.text:
Our services > Clear aligners
Clear aligners are removable plastic trays that gradually straighten teeth. Dr. Tom Alvarez plans every case. Treatment usually takes between 6 and 18 months. We do not currently offer metal braces.

chunks.title: Our services
chunks.heading: Dental implants
chunks.text:
Our services > Dental implants
Dental implants replace a missing tooth with a titanium post and a crown. The process takes several months because the bone needs time to heal. A consultation with a 3D scan is needed before we can confirm a plan.

chunks.title: Our services
chunks.heading: Root canal treatment
chunks.text:
Our services > Root canal treatment
Root canal treatment removes infected tissue from inside a tooth to save it. Most root canals are completed in one or two visits, using local anaesthetic.

chunks.title: Our services
chunks.heading: Children's dentistry
chunks.text:
Our services > Children's dentistry
We see children from age 2. Visits are short and gentle, with fluoride treatment and sealants available. Parents stay with their child during the visit.

chunks.title: Our team
chunks.heading: Dr. Meera Iyer, principal dentist
chunks.text:
Our team > Dr. Meera Iyer, principal dentist
Dr. Iyer leads the practice and focuses on general dentistry, fillings, root canal treatment and dental implants. She has led the practice since it opened.

chunks.title: Our team
chunks.heading: Dr. Tom Alvarez, dentist
chunks.text:
Our team > Dr. Tom Alvarez, dentist
Dr. Alvarez plans our clear aligner cases and looks after children's dentistry.

chunks.title: Our team
chunks.heading: Sam Okafor, dental hygienist
chunks.text:
Our team > Sam Okafor, dental hygienist
Sam carries out professional cleanings and gives home-care advice, including help with brushing technique for children.
